Geographies Served Programs Sports Coaching Facilities District Hyderabad State Telangana District Hyderabad States Telangana Sports Coaching Foundation (SCF) offers a range of modern sports facilities at Masab Tank (Hyderabad) and West Marredpally (Secunderabad Cantonment) that schools and organisations can utilize. These facilities include multi-sports options such as cricket, football, volleyball, kickboxing, gymnastics, tennis, boxing, and basketball. SCF provides comprehensive coaching facilities for various sports, including indoor cricket nets with synthetic astro turf, two electronic bowling machines, a digital speed gun, floodlights for day/night coaching and events, modern tennis coaching, football coaching, basketball coaching, coaching for boxing, karate, and kickboxing, a multi-facility gym for overall physical development, a sports audio-visual hall, and a sports library. These facilities cater to the needs of those seeking professional coaching and training in different sports disciplines. Seminars & Workshops District Hyderabad State Telangana District Hyderabad States Telangana SCF conducts multiple workshops and Seminars on various aspects of sports. It includes the sports facilities in the backdrop of the city of Hyderabad, women in sports, sports medicine, bringing about the transformation of human lives through sports, encouraging CSR activities keeping sports as the centre of social activity. These symposiums are attended by eminent personalities from the city and central administration and subject experts who address the audience on multiple topics relating to sports. Free Tournaments & Events District Hyderabad Nanded State Maharashtra Telangana District Hyderabad Nanded States Maharashtra Telangana SCF regularly hosts free matches and tournaments besides helping renovate sports infrastructure in schools. It hosts these matches between educational institutions, public service agencies and public bodies like police departments. It has also conducted events where the IPL players interacted with needy children encouraging them and kindling hope in their minds along with the social cause of helping out poor tribal children in Nanded, Maharashtra. Build India through Sports Programme District Hyderabad State Telangana District Hyderabad States Telangana This programme of SCF aims to bring sports facilities to every needy child irrespective of their status or social background. It works to improve the availability of fundamental sports facilities and infrastructure to children from the lower strata of society, encourages the development of good sports people, inculcates an atmosphere of fitness leading to fewer diseases, makes sports facilities economical and reasonable to the underprivileged funding them through CSR partnerships and fostering social values of teamwork, peace and mutual esteem. Milestones & Track Record SCF has been promoting health and peace through sports for over 30 years since its establishment in 1991. --> --> Leadership Team Kammela Saibaba Founder, Secretary & Chief Coach K Saibaba Founding Secretary Kammela Srivalli Chairman Demographics & Structure Organisation Strength None M&E Internal, External Assessors No --> Political & Religious Declarations On Affiliation if any No On Deployment Bias if any No --> Registration Details PAN Card AAATT4960C Registration Number 1656 of 1991 CSR Form 1 Not Available VO ID / Darpan ID AP/2015/0087799 --> 80G AAATT4960CF20118 12A AAATT4960CE19914 FCRA 010230878 About Headquarters Hyderabad, Telangana Since 1991 Demographies Served Youth Children --> Impact SCF facilitates sports in more than 300 Government schools and has organised more than 700 free tournaments in its journey of three decades. Vision and Mission SCF's vision is to use sports as a universal tool for empowering underprivileged children and youth with life skills, while its mission is to build India through sports.
